name: White Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 118.5 mg per can, printed above the nutrition panel; the half milligram is the can's own figure, not our rounding
summary: Jolene's plain oat milk latte, read off a can in hand. The panel is topped with 118.5 mg of caffeine for the 8 fl oz can, at 110 calories with 2 g of protein. All 10 g of its sugar is added, and it comes from organic coconut sugar rather than cane; the coffee is organic too. Made in a facility that also processes tree nuts. No price yet: we have not confirmed where Jolene sells it online.
